text_en: The vision of Isaiah son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
text_cn: 在乌齐雅、约堂、阿哈次和希则克雅为犹大王时， 阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚，关于犹大和耶路撒冷所见的异象如下：

text_en: Hear, O heavens, and listen, O earth; for the Lord has spoken: I reared children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against me.
text_cn: 诸天，请谛听！大地，请侧耳！因为上主有话说：“我把孩子抚养长大，他们竟背叛了我！

text_en: The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s crib; but Israel does not know, my people do not understand.
text_cn: 牛认识自己的主人，驴也认识自己主人的槽，以色列却毫不知情，我的百姓却一点不懂。”

text_en: Ah, sinful nation, people laden with iniquity, offspring who do evil, children who deal corruptly, who have forsaken the Lord , who have despised the Holy One of Israel, who are utterly estranged!
text_cn: 祸哉，犯罪的民族，恶贯满盈的百姓，作恶的后裔，败坏的子孙！他们离弃了上主，蔑视了以色列的圣者， 转身背弃了他。

text_en: Why do you seek further beatings? Why do you continue to rebel? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
text_cn: 你们为什么还继续叛逆，再遭受打击呢？整个头已患了病，整个心已经憔悴；

text_en: From the sole of the foot even to the head, there is no soundness in it, but bruises and sores and bleeding wounds; they have not been drained, or bound up, or softened with oil.
text_cn: 从脚掌直到头顶已体无完肤，尽是创痍、伤痕和新的伤口；没有挤净，没有包扎，也没有软膏滋润。

text_en: Your country lies desolate, your cities are burned with fire; in your very presence aliens devour your land; it is desolate, as overthrown by foreigners.
text_cn: 你们的地区变成荒芜，你们的城市被火烧尽，你们面前的庄田被异民吞并，变成一片荒凉，宛如索多玛的废墟；

text_en: And daughter Zion is left like a booth in a vineyard, like a shelter in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.
text_cn: 仅存的熙雍女儿， 有如葡萄园里的茅舍，胡瓜园中的草庐，被围困着的城市。

text_en: If the Lord of hosts had not left us a few survivors, we would have been like Sodom, and become like Gomorrah.
text_cn: 若非万军的上主给我们留下些许残余， 我们早已如同索多玛，相似哈摩辣了。

text_en: Hear the word of the Lord , you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the teaching of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
text_cn: 索多玛的统治者，请听上主的话！哈摩辣的百姓，请听天主的训示：

text_en: What to me is the multitude of your sacrifices? says the Lord ; I have had enough of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed beasts; I do not delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of goats.
text_cn: “你们为什么向我奉献那么多的牺牲？──上主说：我已饱餍（yàn）了公羊的燔祭和肥犊的脂膏；牛犊、羔羊和山羊的血我已不喜欢；

text_en: When you come to appear before me, who asked this from your hand? Trample my courts no more;
text_cn: 你们来见我的面时，谁向你们要求了这些东西？这简直是蹂躏我的殿院。

text_en: bringing offerings is futile; incense is an abomination to me. New moon and sabbath and calling of convocation— I cannot endure solemn assemblies with iniquity.
text_cn: 不要再奉献无谓的祭品！馨香已是我所憎恶；月朔、安息日、集会、斋戒和盛大的宴会，我已都不能容受。

text_en: Your new moons and your appointed festivals my soul hates; they have become a burden to me, I am weary of bearing them.
text_cn: 我的心痛恨你们的月朔和你们的庆节，它们为我是种累赘，使我忍无可忍。

text_en: When you stretch out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you; even though you make many prayers, I will not listen; your hands are full of blood.
text_cn: 你们伸出手时，我必掩目不看；你们行大祈祷时，我决不俯听，因为你们的手染满了血！

text_en: Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean; remove the evil of your doings from before my eyes; cease to do evil,
text_cn: 你们应该洗涤，应该自洁，从我眼前革除你们的恶行，停止作孽，

text_en: learn to do good; seek justice, rescue the oppressed, defend the orphan, plead for the widow.
text_cn: 学习行善，寻求正义，责斥压迫人的人，为孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辩护。

text_en: Come now, let us argue it out, says the Lord : though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be like snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
text_cn: 现在你们来，让我们互相辩论──上主说：你们的罪虽似朱红，将变成雪一样的洁白；虽红得发紫，仍能变成羊毛一样的皎洁。

text_en: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;
text_cn: 假使你们乐意服从，你们将享用地上的美物；

text_en: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured by the sword; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken.
text_cn: 假使你们拒绝反抗，你们将为刀剑所吞灭。”这是上主亲口说的。

text_en: How the faithful city has become a whore! She that was full of justice, righteousness lodged in her— but now murderers!
text_cn: 忠贞的城邑，怎么变成了荡妇！昔日充满着正义，寄居着公平的，现今却住满了谋杀的凶手！

text_en: Your silver has become dross, your wine is mixed with water.
text_cn: 你的银子变成了渣滓，你的美酒搀和了水份；

text_en: Your princes are rebels and companions of thieves. Everyone loves a bribe and runs after gifts. They do not defend the orphan, and the widow’s cause does not come before them.
text_cn: 你的首领谋反作乱，成了盗贼的帮凶；他们都爱好贿赂，索取报酬，不为孤儿伸冤，不受理寡妇的诉讼。

text_en: Therefore says the Sovereign, the Lord of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel: Ah, I will pour out my wrath on my enemies, and avenge myself on my foes!
text_cn: 因此吾主，万军的上主，以色列的大能者说：“哎！我必向我的敌人雪恨，我必向我的仇人复仇。

text_en: I will turn my hand against you; I will smelt away your dross as with lye and remove all your alloy.
text_cn: 我必向你伸出我的手，用炉火炼尽你的渣滓，除去你所有的铅锡。

text_en: And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called the city of righteousness, the faithful city.
text_cn: 我要使你的民长复兴如初；使你的参谋恢复如初；以后你将被称为正义的城市，忠贞的城邑。”

text_en: Zion shall be redeemed by justice, and those in her who repent, by righteousness.
text_cn: 熙雍将因正直获得救赎，她的居民将因正义蒙受救恩；

text_en: But rebels and sinners shall be destroyed together, and those who forsake the Lord shall be consumed.
text_cn: 然而恶人和罪人必将一同灭亡，背弃上主的人必要灭绝。

text_en: For you shall be ashamed of the oaks in which you delighted; and you shall blush for the gardens that you have chosen.
text_cn: 你们必因你们所喜爱的橡树而蒙羞，必因你们所选择的花园而惭愧；

text_en: For you shall be like an oak whose leaf withers, and like a garden without water.
text_cn: 你们将变成一棵落叶的橡树，一座无水的花园。

text_en: The strong shall become like tinder, and their work like a spark; they and their work shall burn together, with no one to quench them.
text_cn: 强者将似麻絮，他的工作犹如火花：二者必要同时焚烧，无人予以熄灭。
